basic_details.job_title: NIT Agartala Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Accountant, Office Intern and Other Posts
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Agartala (NIT Agartala) has announced 5 vacancies for Accountant, Office Intern, Legal Advisor, and Security Officer posts on a contract basis. Qualifications and remuneration vary by post, with monthly pay of Rs. 30,000 for Accountant, Rs. 25,000 for Office Intern, Rs. 50,000 for Security Officer, and remuneration based on mutual discussion for Legal Advisor. The initial contract is for one year, extendable up to 3 years. content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The institute has notified a total of 05 vacancies distributed across four posts on a contract basis. The number of posts is tentative and may increase or decrease.

rows.essential_qualification_required: Bachelor’s degree in commerce from recognized University/institute and proficiency in computer applications, including MS Word, MS Excel and Tally. Retired employees who held analogous posts in the Central Government/ State Government/Autonomous Bodies/PSUs/Central or State Universities.
Bachelor’s Degree in any discipline from a recognized University/Institute with proficiency in computer applications including MS Word, MS Excel, Spreadsheet and Tally.

Bachelor’s degree in law (LL.B.) from a recognized University. Enrolment as an Advocate with a State Bar Council under the Advocates Act, 1961, and minimum 10 years' standing at the Bar as on the last date of application. Retired/working personnel with experience of 20 years and more will be preferred.
Graduate in any discipline. Ex-serviceman retired from Army/Navy/Air Force/Paramilitary Force preferably from the rank of DSP or equivalent with meritorious service records.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The initial engagement for all positions is for a period of one year, and to be considered for further extension up to 2 terms subject to the requirement of the institute and satisfactory work performance, up to a total limit of 3 years (except Legal Advisor, where it is extendable on mutual consent). Remuneration includes monthly consolidated pay: Rs. 30,000/- for Accountant, Rs. 25,000/- for Office Intern, and Rs. 50,000/- for Security Officer, along with TA/DA for official tours/visits as per Institute rules. Remuneration for Legal Advisor is based on mutual discussion.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Agartala Accountant
content_sections.text: Download the application format provided in the official notification PDF. Fill out the application form with correct details in block letters. Affix a passport size photograph on the designated space. Attach self-attested photocopies of all educational and professional certificates, experience certificates, and other required documents. Send the completed application by email to [email protected] on or before 10-11-2026.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process involves shortlisting eligible candidates who will be invited for an interview, interaction, or presentation. The decision of the Institute regarding selection shall be final.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application for NIT Agartala recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by email is 10-11-2026.

faq.question: Q2. Where should candidates send their filled application forms?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their scanned application forms along with self-attested documents to the email address [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. Are these positions permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: All positions are purely on a contract basis for an initial period of one year, extendable up to three years based on performance and institute requirements.

faq.question: Q4. Can retired employees apply for the Accountant and Security Officer posts?
faq.answer: Yes, retired employees who held analogous posts in Central or State Governments, autonomous bodies, PSUs, or universities can apply for the Accountant post, up to 62 years of age. For Security Officer, ex-servicemen from defense or paramilitary forces up to 62 years can apply.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly remuneration for the Office Intern post?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration for the Office Intern post is Rs. 25,000/-.
